title: An editor signs in to the newsroom with Google
description:
Google sign-in is the only way in.

```gherkin
Feature: Newsroom sign-in

  Scenario: An invited editor signs in
    Given an editor who has been added to the editors group
    When they sign in with Google
    Then they reach the newsroom

  Scenario: There is no password form
    Given the sign-in page
    Then it offers Google sign-in only
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Google sign-in prerequisites: Cognito prefix papyrus-the-hallucinator is set on the app. Ryan creates the Google client (origin https://papyrus-the-hallucinator.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com, redirect URI the same plus /oauth2/idpresponse) and runs papyrus site google-secrets set; then the first Amplify build.

comments.author: home
comments.text: First build done 2026-11-13: both passes succeeded (Amplify jobs 3 and 4), the Cognito domain is active, and the Google provider matches the stored client. Next: Ryan's first sign-in, then adding him to the admin group.
